title: A different route for fat
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: Chylomicrons enter lymphatic capillaries called lacteals before reaching the bloodstream. Short-chain fatty acids can follow a different route.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: After long-chain lipid products are packaged into chylomicrons inside intestinal cells, which route normally receives them first? Chylomicrons enter lymphatic capillaries called lacteals before reaching the bloodstream. Short-chain fatty acids can follow a different route.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
